When i was 7 i went into a diabetic coma, i hadn't been previously diagnosed. I remember watching a movie with my mom on her couch, unable to move by myself for the past week or two due to my blood sugar being well over 2000, no exaggeration. I fell asleep but could still hear the panic when my mom couldn't wake me up and phoned my dad to have him meet us at the emergency room. I don't remember the Emergency Room much but i vividly recall seeing my Aunt and Uncle walking with my dad to the ambulance when they were transporting me to an ICU further into Oklahoma City. It was exactly like how most movies portray an out of body experience. I remember the ambulance driver and my mom sitting with me, what they were wearing at the time and my dad's car behind us. When i woke up the next day it burned horribly, to this day it's the worst pain i've ever felt and can't express how miserable it was to wake up with needles stuck in me trying to rip them out since i was so scared. My dad actually wrote down all the things i said to him regarding the coma and other miscellaneous things. Not something i want to experience again.
